277-1809-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-1809-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-1809-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Returned Pastcaller and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4885-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1895-4399-4518-6719.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4518-6719.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6144.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6144.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

341-3532-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
341-3532-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3532-4985-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4985-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.

1528-3616.easyPrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {R}.
1528-3616.description:
Cast Toils of Night and Day by paying {2}{U}.
Holding priority, activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Toils of NIght and Day.
Resolve the copy of Toils of Night and Day, untapping the mana-producing permanent and the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Repeat from step 2.

3188-3197-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-3197-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6753-7060.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4693-6529.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-6529.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

232-1235-5026-5913.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2820-4679-7060.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

151-5261-7014.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
North Pole Patrol does not have summoning sickness.
151-5261-7014.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

284-4050-6972--112.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
284-4050-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1170-1329-1849-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1482-4195-4574-5741.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1640-3041.description:
Deal damage to Coalhauler Swine.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing that much damage to each player. Any damage that would be dealt to you is instead dealt to Coalhauler Swine due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat step 2.

856-5270-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

1940-2034-3490-6783.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1940-2034-3490-6783.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

655-2173-5078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
655-2173-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Golem's Heart triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1737-2099-4853-5004.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, Cathodion and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

600-1543-2369.notablePrerequisites: Jace has at least five loyalty counters on it.
600-1543-2369.description:
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of Jace that aren't legendary.
Activate a Jace token by putting no loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter on it and the other Jace token.
Repeat step 2 using the other Jace token.
Activate a Jace token's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of Jace that aren't legendary.
Repeat from step 2.
600-1543-2369.notes: You may use the infinite Jace tokens to get infinite Illusion creature tokens.

1430-2034-2947.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mirror Image, adding {C}{C}.
When Mirror Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Repeat.

3924-4499-5231.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Deep Forest Hermit.
Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing three Squirrel tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2905-4499-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Pestermite.
Pestermite enters the battlefield, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

851-3899-4871.notablePrerequisites: Spawning Pit has at least two charge counters.
851-3899-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two 2/2 Spawn artifact creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing both Spawns.
The Spawns die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2018-3240-3757-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
Nether Traitor dies, triggering Luminous Broodmoth, returning Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding one mana of any color.
Nether Traitor dies, triggering Felisa, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Inkling, adding one mana of any color.
The Inkling dies, triggering Nether Traitor, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2302-3082-4050-4215.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Triumph of Saint Katherine, adding one mana of any color.
Triumph of Saint Katherine dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Triumph of Saint Katherine trigger, exiling it and the top six cards of your library into a face-down pile, then shuffling that pile and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Triumph of Saint Katherine and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1703-2034-3821.notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Peregrine Drake.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1703-2034-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, adding {C}{C}.
Fool's Demise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning Fool's Demise to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.
If the five lands can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.
